title: Trump responds after shots fired at correspondents’ dinner, says shooter arrested
byline: President Donald Trump responds after an alleged shooter opened fire inside the hotel where the correspondents’ dinner was being held.

title: Mainly fair weather expected in parts of the island
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and Northwestern provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts after 2.00 pm, today (26), the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Trump safe after being rushed from White House correspondents dinner as attendees take cover
byline: President Donald Trump and first lady Melania Trump were rushed out of the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner by Secret Service agents on Saturday night after a loud, unidentified noise.
